title: Watch::Watching names a watcher thread nothing holds
trigger: Linux: a screen-reader query starts the D-Bus watcher with spawn_guarded and its handle is dropped; the thread blocks on the bus and ends only through EndGuard
effect: If the thread ends without running EndGuard the stage stays Watching and the watcher is never restarted
fix: Watch::Watching { thread: JoinHandle } polled with is_finished, like window_save::Writer::Running

title: baseline: RichHtmlStage::Running is bare
trigger: Save a rich message as HTML: the stage is a bare Running in an Arc<Mutex>, the worker thread is detached
effect: None today; leaving the owner cannot cancel the worker except through the WorkerLink drop

title: baseline: Beats::Running { count } is a counter, not a request
trigger: A second launch forwards its args; serve() marks the counter and waits for it to move
fix: Running { last_beat: Instant }, or allow-list the counter with a reason

title: baseline: RowDownload::Running(Transfer) is keyed by dictionary code only
trigger: Download a dictionary, fail, retry: progress is matched by the code string, not by the download that owns it
effect: None today (one download at a time)
fix: Running { download: Progress handle / Task, code }

title: baseline: Writer::Running { in_flight } holds no thread
trigger: A settings save spawns a detached drain thread; WriterExit resets the stage only on panic

title: install() replaces the .aff before the .dic, so a failure between them leaves a mismatched pair
trigger: Re-download an installed dictionary while the .dic is held open (Windows): the new .aff is renamed in, the .dic rename fails
effect: The dictionary parses wrongly or not at all until the next successful download, yet discover_dictionaries lists it
fix: Stage both files as .part, then rename the pair, undoing the first on failure

title: InstantViewAsk entries are not removed when the getWebPageInstantView request is lost
trigger: Click an Instant View link, then the request is dropped by a flood-retry give-up or an account drain (settle_lost_request)
effect: messages.instant_view_requests keeps the entry (URL) for good and the click opens neither the reader nor the browser fallback
fix: Remove the entry in settle_lost_request, or carry the ask on the PendingRequest
